effect_description_eng:
[Main] Until the end of your opponent's turn, 1 of their Digimon gains "[End of Your Turn] Delete this Digimon." Then, place this card in the battle area.
[End of Opponent's Turn] If you have a Digimon with [Lilithmon] in its name, ＜Delay＞ (By trashing this card after the placing turn, activate the effect below.)
・Delete 1 of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Delete 1 of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon.
